#HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus):

•Respiratory virus, Found in 2001
•Symptoms: Cough, fever, congestion, wheezing
•High Risk: Pneumonia/bronchitis
•Treatment: No cure, only symptom relief
•Prevent: Hygiene, cover coughs, clean surfaces
